messages.content: 洛杉磯和柏林之間的時差是多少？

message.content:
洛杉磯（Pacific Time，UTC−8/−7）與柏林（Central European Time，UTC+1/+2）的時差通常是 **9 小時**。  
但在夏令時間調整期間（春季和秋季），兩地會先後進入或退出夏令時間，這段時間內時差會變成 **10 小時**。  

簡單說：

| 時期 | 洛杉磯 | 柏林 | 時差 |
|------|--------|------|------|
| 標準時間 | UTC−8 | UTC+1 | +9 小時 |
| 夏令時間 | UTC−7 | UTC+2 | +9 小時 |
| 春季/秋季轉換期 | 一方已調整、另一方未調整 |  | +10 小時 |

因此，平常你可以用「柏林比洛杉磯早 9 小時」來計算，但在夏令時間切換前後要留意可能出現的 10 小時差距。

Berlin is Central European Time (CET) UTC+1 standard, UTC+2 during DST. So the difference depends on whether both are observing DST at the same time. Typically, when both are on DST, LA is UTC-7, Berlin is UTC+2, so difference is 9 hours. When both are on standard time, LA is UTC-8, Berlin is UTC+1, difference is also 9 hours. However, there is a period in spring and fall where one is on DST and the other is not, causing a 10 hour difference. For example, in early March, Berlin moves to DST before LA does, so difference becomes 10 hours. Similarly, in late October, LA moves to DST after Berlin does, difference becomes 10 hours.
